name: Vesper
subtitle: Stream, download and sync your library
description: Vesper is a media player written in Swift for iOS. It connects to external services and add-ons to display, stream and download content.

apps.name: Vesper
apps.subtitle: Stream, download and sync your library
apps.localizedDescription:
Vesper is a media player for iOS.

• Browse movies and shows with cast, ratings and related titles.
• Stream from Stremio add-ons or your own Usenet provider.
• Use the built-in player, or hand off to VLC, Infuse or Outplayer.
• Download titles to watch offline.
• Home Screen widgets for Continue Watching, Up Next and your Library.
• Sync your library and add-ons with iCloud, and your history with Trakt or SIMKL.

Vesper has no ads or analytics and doesn't include any content. Requires iOS 27 or later.
apps.versionDescription:
• Introduced widgets for Continue Watching, Up Next and your Library.
• New app icon.
• Cleaned up the API entry pages.
• iCloud sync for your library and add-ons.
• Various UI refinements.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vesper connects to add-ons and video sources on your local network.
